states.claim: profile points to the image's EXIF StringInfo profile, or is NULL if no EXIF profile exists.
exif points to the byte storage region of the EXIF profile data.
directory is initialized to point into the exif storage region at the first IFD offset.
directory_stack entries store directory pointers, entry indices, and tag offsets for nested IFD traversal.
directory is restored from directory_stack when a nested IFD level is popped.
q points to the current 12-byte directory entry within the exif storage region.
p points to the inline value bytes within the directory entry when the value fits in 4 bytes.
p points into the exif storage region at the offset stored in the directory entry when the value does not fit inline.
exif_resources is a newly created splay tree used to track visited directory entries.
states.evidence:
L576: exif_resources=NewSplayTree((int (*)(const void *,const void *)) NULL,
L577: (void *(*)(void *)) NULL,(void *(*)(void *)) NULL);

states.claim: exif_resources is destroyed at function exit.
value is a heap-allocated string produced by AcquireString or AcquireQuantumMemory, or NULL if allocation failed.
value is released with DestroyString after being used.
key is a heap-allocated string produced by AcquireString and released with DestroyString.
p1 is initialized from p and advanced by size for each component in the EXIFMultipleValues and EXIFMultipleFractions macros.

values.claim: tag_bytes is a 13-element int array indexed by format; tag_bytes[format] gives the byte size per component for format values 0..12.
format is checked against sizeof(tag_bytes)/sizeof(*tag_bytes) (13) before indexing tag_bytes, and format==0 is rejected.
number_bytes = components * tag_bytes[format], computed as size_t from a nonnegative ssize_t components; overflow is detected by number_bytes < components.
When number_bytes <= 4, p points to q+8 (inline value in the 12-byte directory entry); otherwise p is set from an offset into exif.
For out-of-line values, dir_offset must be nonnegative and < length, dir_offset+number_bytes must not overflow and must be <= length, and p = exif+dir_offset.
Before formatting, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-tag_bytes[format].
For BYTE/UNDEFINED and STRING formats, value is allocated with AcquireQuantumMemory(number_bytes+1, sizeof(*value)) when ~number_bytes >= 1, and value[number_bytes] is set to '\0'.
For STRING/default format, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-number_bytes before reading number_bytes bytes.
In EXIFMultipleValues/EXIFMultipleFractions, p1 starts at p and advances by size bytes per component for components iterations.
values.evidence:
L35: p1=p; \
L36: for (component=0; component < components; component++) \
L42: p1+=size; \

values.claim: In EXIFMultipleValues/EXIFMultipleFractions, length accumulates FormatLocaleString output and is clamped to MaxTextExtent-1 when it reaches MaxTextExtent-1.
The first IFD offset read from exif+4 must be nonnegative and < length; directory = exif+offset.
directory must lie within [exif, exif+length-2].
q = directory + 12*entry + 2, and q must be <= exif+length-12.
number_entries is read as an unsigned short from directory.
tag_value = ReadPropertyUnsignedShort(endian,q) + tag_offset.
A nested IFD offset must be < length and level < MaxDirectoryStack-2 to push onto directory_stack.
Before reading the next-IFD offset, directory+2+12*number_entries+4 must be <= exif+length.
The next-IFD offset must be nonzero, < length, and level < MaxDirectoryStack-2 to push another directory.
tag_offset1 is 0x10000 when tag_value == TAG_GPS_OFFSET, otherwise 0.
For '#'/'@' tag specifications, strlen(property) must equal 4 and n is set to 1 before parsing 4 hex digits into tag.
length = GetStringInfoLength(profile); length must be >= 6 to proceed and >= 16 after locating the EXIF header.
